company.name: Erasca
company.shortDescription: Erasca is a developer of oncology drugs intended to provide precision oncology options.
company.description:
Erasca develops oncology drugs intended to provide precision oncology options. The company's drugs are being developed through multiple discovery programs for undisclosed targets that are biological drivers of cancer and are pursuing additional opportunities for pipeline expansion through academic and biopharmaceutical collaborations, providing patients with new potential solutions to not just treat but cure cancer.

Erasca was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Erasca is researching small molecule KRAS inhibitors, including tricyclic KRAS G12C and G12D inhibitors, amide and urea containing tricyclic KRAS inhibitors, aminoheterocycle substituted tricyclic KRAS inhibitors, selective KRAS inhibitors, and KRAS inhibitor conjugates, as described in titles such as Tricyclic KRAS inhibitors and Tricyclic pyridones and pyrimidones and in abstracts focused on compounds of Formula I for treating cancer. These efforts span precision targeting of KRAS driven malignancies.
